desc: Stay Light. Stay Strong. The SOCOM762-Ti2 enhances Surefire’s exceptional titanium suppressor line by providing the ultimate lightweight suppressor for 7.62 mm and .308-caliber bolt-action rifles. We designed it to exceed military sniper rifle suppressor specifications, making it the ideal lightweight suppressor for hunters and long-range precision shooters alike. SureFire's strict manufacturing tolerances and exacting attention to bore concentricity and suppressor alignment result in tremendous accuracy. Constructed primarily of titanium, the SOCOM762-Ti2 weighs a mere 11 ounces while maintaining our strictest durability standards, so you won't even feel it at the end of your barrel. Inside, its Direct Metal Laser Sintered, V-shaped titanium baffle stack significantly provides an unprecedented level of baffle alignment and structural integrity. The SOCOM762-Ti2 attenuates the muzzle report significantly, and our internal venting technology evenly distributes thermodynamic gases, greatly reducing pressure impulse effects on the projectile as it clears the muzzle. The SOCOM762-Ti2 is a durable 7.62/.308 titanium suppressor without equal.
